record.reason: CliniDial is medical-primary teamwork analysis during simulated clinical operations. Physical pages 2–4 describe 22 malignant-hyperthermia surgical simulation sessions, six participants/session, 6.5k turns, 49.9k words, two camera angles and nine simulated physiological signals, with Seek/Evaluate/Plan/Implement labels and 17/2/3-session ten-fold classification splits. Page 9 reports best macro F1 51.09 and explicitly warns that simulated operations lack real clinical urgency; audio was collected but not evaluated here. These are mannequin scenarios, not patient outcome or real-operative safety validation.
